pages.summary: Roof leak assessment and waterproofing around membrane surfaces, penetrations and outlets. Safe roof access and the type of roof assembly determine the work that can be inspected.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Roof Leaks & Waterproofing in Canberra

Roof leak assessment and waterproofing around membrane surfaces, penetrations and outlets. Safe roof access and the type of roof assembly determine the work that can be inspected.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Eaves leak records for roof repair assessment

Describe where it appears, whether gutters visibly overflow and whether a ceiling or wall inside is also affected. Eaves dripping during rain can involve roof or gutter details; the observation does not identify a membrane defect. Report what you can see from a safe position on the ground and let the assessment determine any access needed.

Roof-to-wall junction leak assessment details

Note the affected room, the weather when the leak starts and any previous flashing or roof repairs. Existing plans or photographs can help describe the roof construction. Ask the proposed scope to identify the affected junction and any separate roofing or drainage task before choosing a treatment. Discuss the roof leak with MEL ONE; if water instead appears around a window or doorway, see external water ingress repairs.

Roof leak inspection and treatment boundaries

The inspection considers accessible membrane seams, flashing interfaces, penetration bases and outlets against the room and weather reported. Water can travel from a roof-to-wall junction before it appears inside, so the internal stain is only one clue.

A local membrane or junction repair needs a compatible, sound surrounding system. Wider deterioration may require membrane renewal. Roof painting does not repair a failed flashing or penetration; roof-covering replacement, gutter alterations and separately licensed roofing or drainage work are listed apart from waterproofing.

Roof leaks during heavy rain

Wind-driven rain, overflowing gutters, blocked outlets and a vulnerable flashing or wall junction can each change where water enters. A stain inside the building does not always sit directly below the entry point. Record the weather, affected room and any safe exterior photographs before arranging a roof leak assessment.

Roof painting and waterproofing system differences

A coating described as roof paint is not automatically a repair for a failed flashing, penetration or waterproofing membrane. The existing roof assembly and the confirmed water path determine the work scope. If a roof-covering repair needs a licensed roofer, the quote lists that task separately from the Ellis team’s waterproofing work.

Roof waterproofing scope

The written quote identifies safe access equipment, the membrane or junction being treated, substrate preparation and any separate roof or drainage tasks. Weather exposure and the condition of the roof may affect when work can proceed.

  • Review of the reported leak timing, roof surface, penetrations, flashings and adjacent wall junctions where safely accessible.
  • Identification of whether the agreed path is a local roof repair, a membrane detail or related drainage work.
  • A clear written scope for the Ellis team’s waterproofing work and any separately licensed roof or drainage task before work begins.

Waterproofing repair and access arrangements

  1. Describe the affected room, rain conditions and any ground-level observation of overflowing gutters or outlets.
  2. Let the team arrange safe access and an on-site assessment of the relevant roof details.
  3. Agree the written quote, weather window, membrane repair boundaries and any coordinated roofing work.

Isaacs roof waterproofing scope →

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Request roof leak assessment

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Stay on the ground when recording roof symptoms. Keep away from sagging ceilings and water near electrical fittings; active water and electrical hazards need prompt appropriate assistance.

External Waterproofing & Water Ingress Repairs

Explore the related MEL ONE waterproofing service.

Waterproofing or Drainage Guide

Read the related MEL ONE guide for property owners.

Roof waterproofing in Isaacs, Woden Valley: April 2026

In April 2026, the Ellis team completed roof waterproofing work at a property in Isaacs, Woden Valley. The work covered roof details around the chimney, ventilation outlets and eaves drainage outlets. These details were part of the project scope, rather than roof painting alone.

Waterproofing substrate preparation

Our substrate repair sequence is cleaning, repair, levelling and application of the selected waterproofing materials. Depending on the agreed system, roof work can involve laying a waterproofing membrane, applying a barrier coating and treating joints with a suitable waterproofing sealant. Materials are selected for the site; these stages are not a tile-regrouting specification.

Roof membranes and moisture barriers have different roles. A sheet membrane needs suitable seams and terminations; an exposed system must be specified for its conditions. As manufacturer examples, ARDEX WPM 185 is a cap sheet for exposed membrane systems, while ARDEX WPM 300 is an epoxy primer/barrier coating. These examples explain the distinction, not the products used on the Isaacs project.

Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉屋顶漏水和防水

屋顶渗漏评估以及膜表面、渗透和出口周围的防水。安全屋顶通道和屋顶组件的类型决定了可以检查的工作。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 受到澳大利亚 10,000 多家客户信赖的物业维护和维修服务。对于堪培拉的紧急工作，Ellis团队可以在联系后最快 30 分钟内到达现场。抵达时间取决于当前的可用性、地址和安全进场条件。

屋檐漏水记录用于屋顶修复评估

描述它出现的位置、排水沟是否明显溢出以及内部的天花板或墙壁是否也受到影响。下雨时屋檐滴水可能涉及屋顶或排水沟细节；观察结果并未发现膜缺陷。报告您从地面安全位置可以看到的情况，并让评估确定所需的访问权限。

屋顶到墙壁连接处泄漏评估详细信息

注意受影响的房间、泄漏开始时的天气以及之前的任何防水板或屋顶维修。现有的平面图或照片可以帮助描述屋顶结构。在选择处理方法之前，询问建议范围以确定受影响的连接处以及任何单独的屋顶或排水任务。 与 MEL ONE 讨论屋顶漏水问题;如果窗户或门口周围出现水，请参阅 外部进水维修.

屋顶渗漏检查和处理边界

检查考虑了可触及的膜接缝、防水接口、渗透底座和出口与房间和报告的天气的关系。水可以从屋顶到墙壁的交界处流动，然后才出现在内部，因此内部污渍只是一个线索。

局部膜或连接处修复需要兼容、健全的周围系统。更广泛的恶化可能需要膜更新。屋顶涂漆不能修复失败的防水板或渗透；除防水外，还列出了屋顶覆盖物更换、排水沟改造以及单独许可的屋顶或排水工程。

大雨时屋顶漏水

风雨、溢流的排水沟、堵塞的出水口以及脆弱的防水板或墙壁连接处都会改变水进入的位置。建筑物内的污渍并不总是位于入口点的正下方。在安排屋顶渗漏评估之前，记录天气、受影响的房间和任何安全的外部照片。

屋顶涂漆和防水系统的区别

被描述为屋顶涂料的涂层并不能自动修复失效的防水膜、渗透膜或防水膜。现有的屋顶组件和已确认的水路确定了工作范围。如果屋顶覆盖维修需要有执照的屋顶工，报价单会将该任务与Ellis团队的防水工作分开列出。

屋面防水范围

书面报价确定了安全通道设备、正在处理的膜或连接处、基材准备以及任何单独的屋顶或排水任务。天气暴露和屋顶状况可能会影响工作的进行。

  • 审查报告的泄漏时间、屋顶表面、渗透、防水板和可安全到达的相邻墙壁连接处。
  • 确定商定的路径是否是局部屋顶修复、膜细节或相关排水工程。
  • 在工作开始前，Ellis团队的防水工作以及任何单独许可的屋顶或排水任务有明确的书面范围。

防水维修和通道安排

  1. 描述受影响的房间、降雨情况以及溢流排水沟或排水口的任何地面观察结果。
  2. 让团队安排安全通道并对相关屋顶细节进行现场评估。
  3. 同意书面报价、天气窗口、薄膜修复边界和任何协调的屋顶工作。

我们的基材修复顺序是清洁、修复、找平和涂抹所选防水材料。根据商定的系统，屋顶工程可能涉及铺设防水膜、涂敷隔离涂层以及使用合适的防水密封剂处理接缝。为现场选择材料；这些阶段不是瓷砖重新填缝规范。

屋顶膜和防潮层具有不同的作用。片状膜需要合适的接缝和端接；暴露系统必须指定其条件。作为制造商的例子， 亚地斯 WPM 185 是暴露膜系统的盖板，而 亚地斯 WPM 300 是一种环氧底漆/隔离涂层。这些示例解释了区别，而不是 Isaacs 项目中使用的产品。

pages.title: Shower Resealing & Regrouting in Canberra
pages.summary: Replace deteriorated shower grout and silicone where a surface joint repair suits the condition. Resealing and regrouting do not replace a failed membrane beneath the tiles.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Shower Resealing & Regrouting in Canberra

Replace deteriorated shower grout and silicone where a surface joint repair suits the condition. Resealing and regrouting do not replace a failed membrane beneath the tiles.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Shower screen leaks and resealing assessment

A local screen-perimeter repair may be suitable if assessment identifies an accessible failed joint as the water path. Tell us whether water first appears at the screen base, beside the door or outside a tiled corner. The screen arrangement and its drainage details need consideration before deciding which joints should be sealed. Adding silicone wherever water is visible can miss the actual entry point.

Old silicone removal before joint resealing

The condition of the joint and its bonding surfaces matters. The agreed repair should identify the failed material to remove and the preparation needed for the replacement sealant. Loose grout, damaged tiles or movement may change the scope. Ask which screen edges or tiled junctions are included and which surrounding surfaces will be retained.

Silicone repair and concealed membrane failure

Silicone is a joint sealant; it does not replace the membrane beneath tiled finishes. If moisture continues beyond the shower or returns after a surface repair, use the leaking shower assessment service to review the cause. The repair options guide explains when grout, sealant or broader waterproofing work may be relevant. Describe the affected joints before choosing a repair.

Shower grout and silicone repair suitability

We check missing grout between tiles, split silicone at changes of plane, screen junctions and signs of tile movement. Old silicone, residue and damp joint surfaces affect preparation and the bond of the replacement sealant.

Grout fills tile joints; flexible sealant serves movement joints. Neither treatment repairs a concealed membrane failure or a plumbing leak. Persistent moisture after a previous surface repair needs reassessment before more grout or silicone is applied.

Grout and silicone repair scope

The quote identifies grout removal depth, joint preparation, replacement materials and the joints being treated. Loose tiles or damaged substrates may require a separate repair scope before regrouting.

  • Inspection of grout, silicone, screen edges and other accessible shower junctions.
  • Removal of failed sealant or grout from the defined repair area.
  • New grout, silicone and agreed finishing work, or a clear recommendation when broader waterproofing is required.

Waterproofing repair and access arrangements

  1. Identify the worn grout or silicone joints and describe any leak that continued after earlier repairs.
  2. Agree removal of old silicone or deteriorated grout, cleaning and drying before the selected repair.
  3. Keep the shower out of use for the specified preparation and curing periods, then follow the written handover instructions.

Tile regrouting and epoxy grout

MEL ONE also regrouts tiled floors outside the bathroom. Tell us which room needs attention and whether the problem is worn grout, loose tiles or a leak. The quote identifies the area, old grout removal, preparation and replacement grout.

Epoxy regrouting is available where suitable for the tiles and conditions. Our epoxy versus cement grout explanation helps you compare materials. For outdoor tiled areas, see standalone balcony regrouting and waterproofing.

Tile joint repair photographs →

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Request shower joint repairs

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Clear toiletries and keep the shower dry as arranged. Allow access along screen edges and wall-to-floor junctions without removing fixtures yourself.

Leaking Shower Repairs

Explore the related MEL ONE waterproofing service.

Bathroom Waterproofing & Retiling

Explore the related MEL ONE waterproofing service.

Grout, sealant and bond breakers are not interchangeable

Grout fills appropriate fixed tile joints. Flexible sealants and bond breakers form part of specified movement-joint or membrane details; they are not substitutes for grout across a tiled floor. Product compatibility and the condition found on site determine the choice. See tile regrouting and epoxy grout options for tiled areas beyond the shower, or the Sika waterproofing guidance for the role of bond breakers.

Waterproofing repair guides and project photographs

Explore the repair options and relevant work photographs, then talk with us about your property.

pages.title: 堪培拉的淋浴重新密封和重新填缝
pages.summary: 在表面接缝修复适合的情况下更换损坏的淋浴填缝和硅胶。重新密封和重新填缝不会更换瓷砖下方失效的薄膜。
pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉的淋浴重新密封和重新填缝

在表面接缝修复适合的情况下更换损坏的淋浴填缝和硅胶。重新密封和重新填缝不会更换瓷砖下方失效的薄膜。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 受到澳大利亚 10,000 多家客户信赖的物业维护和维修服务。对于堪培拉的紧急工作，Ellis团队可以在联系后最快 30 分钟内到达现场。抵达时间取决于当前的可用性、地址和安全进场条件。

淋浴屏泄漏和重新密封评估

如果评估确定可触及的故障接头为水路，则局部滤网周边修复可能是合适的。告诉我们水是否首先出现在屏幕底座、门旁边或瓷砖角落外面。在决定应密封哪些接缝之前，需要考虑滤网的布置及其排水细节。在可见水的地方添加硅胶可能会错过实际的进入点。

重新密封接头之前去除旧硅胶

接头及其粘合表面的状况很重要。商定的维修应确定要去除的失效材料以及更换密封剂所需的准备工作。松动的水泥基填缝剂、损坏的瓷砖或移动可能会改变范围。询问包括哪些屏幕边缘或平铺连接处以及将保留哪些周围表面。

硅胶修复和隐蔽膜失效

硅胶是一种接缝密封剂；它不会取代瓷砖饰面下方的薄膜。如果淋浴后湿气持续存在或在表面修复后再次出现，请使用 淋浴漏水评估服务 来检查原因。的 维修选项指南 解释何时需要进行填缝、密封剂或更广泛的防水工作。 说明需要维修的接缝 在选择维修之前。

淋浴填缝和硅胶修复适用性

我们检查瓷砖之间缺失的填缝、平面变化处的硅胶裂痕、屏幕连接处以及瓷砖移动的迹象。旧的硅胶、残留物和潮湿的接缝表面会影响替换密封剂的准备和粘合。

瓷砖接缝处填满水泥基填缝剂；柔性密封剂用于伸缩接缝。这两种处理方法都无法修复隐藏的膜故障或管道泄漏。先前的表面修复后的持续潮湿需要在涂抹更多的水泥基填缝剂或硅酮密封胶之前重新评估。

填缝和硅胶修复范围

报价确定了填缝清除深度、接缝准备、更换材料和正在处理的接缝。松动的瓷砖或损坏的基材在重新填缝之前可能需要单独的维修范围。

  • 检查填缝、硅胶、屏幕边缘和其他可触及的淋浴连接处。

pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Tile Regrouting in Canberra

MEL ONE provides local tile regrouting for worn or damaged tile joints, including tiled floors outside bathrooms. Discuss cement or epoxy grout options and joint resealing according to the condition and use of the area.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

Tile grout and movement joint repair assessment

Missing grout between tiles, a split seal at a wall edge and a leak through the membrane are different problems. Tell us whether the concern is worn grout, stained joints, loose tiles or water appearing in another room. That helps define whether you need tile regrouting, joint resealing or a waterproofing assessment.

We accept tile regrouting enquiries for tiled floors beyond bathrooms, as well as showers and balconies. For a shower screen or shower perimeter, start with shower resealing and regrouting. For an outdoor tiled area with ponding or leakage below, see balcony waterproofing.

Tile grout and joint sealing material selection

Cement-based grout, epoxy grout and flexible sealants serve different purposes. Epoxy grout may suit a stain-prone tiled area, but it is not a repair for a failed membrane beneath tiles. The choice depends on the tile finish, joint dimensions, location and condition found on site. The quote should identify the proposed material rather than treating every joint alike.

Sealant is used for appropriate flexible joints. A bond breaker controls adhesion within a specified joint or membrane detail so movement can be accommodated; it is not tile grout. An epoxy moisture-barrier coating is also not epoxy grout. Read our guide to regrouting, resealing and membrane replacement before choosing a repair based only on the word “epoxy”.

Regrouting suitability and concealed leak limitations

A local grout or seal repair may be appropriate where the defect is limited to that joint. Recurring dampness after resealing, loose tiles or water reaching the room below needs further assessment. Regrouting the surface does not replace a concealed waterproofing membrane or repair damaged backing.

Tile regrouting quote factors

Share the suburb, approximate tiled area, indoor or outdoor location, tile type and the condition of the joints. Mention any previous repairs and whether water is escaping. Access, preparation, joint condition, selected materials and any separate tile or membrane work affect the scope. We do not assume that new grout alone will resolve an unexplained leak.

Photos are optional. Send a wide view and a close-up of the affected joints if safely accessible, or arrange a site visit without them. The written quote should distinguish fixed tile joints from movement joints and identify any work outside the grout repair.

The same tiled area before and after joint repair.

pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉的瓷砖重新铺设

MEL ONE 为磨损或损坏的瓷砖接缝提供局部瓷砖重新填缝服务，包括浴室外的瓷砖地板。根据该区域的条件和用途讨论水泥或环氧树脂填缝的选择以及接缝的重新密封。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

瓷砖填缝和移动接缝修复评估

瓷砖之间的填缝缺失、墙边缘的密封裂开以及薄膜渗漏都是不同的问题。告诉我们问题是否在于另一个房间出现磨损的水泥基填缝剂、污渍的接缝、松动的瓷砖或水。这有助于确定您是否需要瓷砖重新填缝、接缝重新密封或防水评估。

我们接受浴室、淋浴间和阳台以外的瓷砖地板的瓷砖重新填缝询问。对于淋浴屏或淋浴周边，请从 淋浴重新密封和重新填缝。对于下面有积水或渗漏的室外瓷砖区域，请参见 阳台防水.

瓷砖填缝剂和接缝密封材料的选择

水泥基填缝、环氧填缝和柔性密封剂具有不同的用途。环氧树脂填缝可能适合容易沾污的瓷砖区域，但它不能修复瓷砖下方失效的膜。选择取决于瓷砖表面处理、接缝尺寸、位置和现场条件。报价应明确所提议的材料，而不是对每个接缝都一视同仁。

密封剂用于适当的柔性接头。防水层隔离材料控制指定接头或膜细节内的粘附力，以便可以适应运动；它不是瓷砖填缝。环氧防潮涂层也不是环氧填缝。阅读我们的 重新填缝、重新密封和膜更换指南 在仅根据“环氧树脂”一词选择修复之前。

重新填缝的适用性和隐藏的泄漏限制

如果缺陷仅限于该接缝，则可能需要进行局部填缝或密封修复。重新密封后反复潮湿、瓷砖松动或水到达下面的房间需要进一步评估。重新浇注表面并不能更换隐藏的防水膜或修复损坏的背衬。

瓷砖重新填缝报价因素

分享郊区、大概的瓷砖面积、室内或室外位置、瓷砖类型和接缝状况。提及之前的任何维修以及是否漏水。通道、准备工作、接缝条件、所选材料以及任何单独的瓷砖或膜工作都会影响范围。我们并不认为仅使用新的水泥基填缝剂就能解决不明原因的泄漏问题。

照片并非必需。如能安全拍摄，可提供整体照片和问题接缝的特写；也可以直接安排现场评估。书面报价应区分固定瓷砖接缝与伸缩接缝，并列明填缝维修范围以外的工作。

接缝修复前后的瓷砖面积相同。
